Hub at /services/ currently has: soft cream hero with small thumbnail collage on right, H1 + 2 CTAs, then a separate white chip-nav section (4 category pills), then a FLAGSHIP SERVICES 2-col card grid, then 4 category sections each with identical 3-col equal card grids (image on top, title, 1-line desc, Explore). YOUR JOB:
1. Research modern B2B service catalog / agency services index patterns (2024-2026): what works for hero, category nav, service listing density, featured vs equal cards. Prefer patterns used by strong SaaS/agency sites (Linear-like density is wrong; think Stripe/Vercel/agency portfolio hubs, Notion marketplace-ish catalogs, consulting firm service indexes).
2. Validate or reject each draft recommendation against UX principles: first-viewport brand+job clarity, one composition, avoid dashboard feel, cards only when interactive, no hero overlays/badges, no purple AI look, professional Amazon agency tone.
3. Given OBSERVED current issues (from screenshots description):

   - Chip nav: orphaned white strip after hero; looks bolted-on; 4 equal pills.
   - Catalog: FLAGSHIP then 4 identical grids = repetitive monotony; mobile same stacked cards forever; no hierarchy within category.
4. Produce a VALIDATED layout prescription with confidence labels (Verified pattern / Observed issue / Proposed / Assumed). Concrete structure for desktop + mobile. Name what to KEEP from current hub (stack, proof, FAQ, CTA, 15 links, SEO).
5. Reject anything that would hurt SEO URL preservation or feel like generic AI landing page.

Return: (A) Visual diagnosis of current hub (B) Research findings with pattern names (C) Counsel verdict ACCEPT/MODIFY/REJECT on draft ink-hero+sticky-rail plan with specific modifications (D) Final recommended section order and component behavior.

Be concise, professional, evidence-language only.

input.final_summary: Counsel verdict: **MODIFY** the ink-hero + sticky-rail draft. Keep the dark stage and mixed featured/compact catalog; soften the sticky rail so it is not a bolted-on pill dashboard; reject collage heroes, equal card grids, and marketplace search chrome. Preserve `/services/`, all 15 links, stack, proof, FAQ, and CTA.

content.text:
## A) Visual diagnosis (current hub)

| Issue | Label | Finding |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Cream hero + weak brand signal | Observed (screenshots) / Assumed vs current `services-index-hero.tsx` | First viewport does not pass brand test: logo lives only in nav; H1 carries the job alone. Eyebrow “SERVICES” / “eCom Gliders services” is inventory language, not brand stage. |
| Thumbnail collage on right | Observed | Reads as stock/AI product stills, not a confident stage. Empty cream field + small collage = split composition, not one plane. |
| Competing dual CTAs | Observed + Verified config | Audit + phone as peer buttons split the single job of the viewport. |
| Chip-nav orphan strip | Observed + Verified `services-index-nav.tsx` | Separate muted section after hero; four equal bordered pills feel bolted-on, not part of the catalog. |
| Flagship then four identical grids | Observed + Verified categories | Hierarchy exists in content (`featured`, flagship band) but layout repeats the same image-card grammar. Mobile becomes endless stacked cards. |
| SEO / URL stack below fold | Verified | Stack, proof, results, FAQ, CTA, `/services/` canonical, 15 root slug links — structurally sound; not the visual problem. |

**Job of the page (Assumed buyer intent):** Orient by capability → pick one service detail URL → optional audit. Not browse a marketplace of hundreds.

---

## B) Research findings (pattern names)

| Pattern | Source | Confidence | Transfer to eCom Gliders |
|---------|--------|------------|---------------------------|
| **Marketplace catalog** — H1 + sticky/side category filters + Featured band + denser grid | Vercel Marketplace (Verified Playwright 2026-10-05); Notion gallery case studies (Observed) | High for large catalogs | Borrow Featured + density hierarchy only. Reject search, type filters, sidebar dashboards for 15 services. |
| **Featured-with-list** — one large interactive entry + compact sibling rows | Shadcn “Featured With List”; Stripe-style progressive disclosure / bento hierarchy (Observed secondary sources) | High | Best fit per category (3–5 items). |
| **Editorial list / index rows** — full-width title + one-line outcome + text CTA; minimal chrome | Pravin Kumar, editorial lists for service pages (2026; cites attention/heatmap claims — treat conversion lift as Reported, not independently verified) | Medium | Strong for mobile and non-flagship items; avoids card monotony. |
| **Quiet in-page anchors** — category jump once below hero; sticky optional | Editorial counsel: sticky competes with global nav; Baymard: sticky helps deep category scroll | Medium (tension) | Soft sticky rail only after hero exits; text links, not pill chrome. |
| **Equal peer card grid** — 3-col icon/image cards | Common agency/SaaS blocks | High as anti-pattern here | Valid only for 3–6 true peers. Wrong for 15 services × 4 identical sections. |
| **Ink / dark authority stage** | Agency competitive notes (Canopy-style dark heroes in project Design System); Stripe product pages use strong dark product stages (Observed) | Medium–High | Accept if brand-forward, no purple glow, no overlay badges, no AI collage. |

Linear-like ultra-dense tables: wrong tone for a marketing agency hub (Assumed / counsel).

---

## C) Counsel verdict on draft: ink hero + sticky rail + mixed rows

**Overall: MODIFY** (not full ACCEPT, not REJECT).

| Draft piece | Verdict | Modifications |
|-------------|---------|----------------|
| Ink hero stage | **ACCEPT with constraints** | One composition: ink full-bleed stage; brand wordmark or logo as hero-level signal; H1 = Amazon growth job; one short supporting line; **one** primary CTA (audit). Phone as quiet text link. **Reject** cream panel, thumbnail collage, eyebrow “SERVICES”, floating badges, purple/glow AI look. Stage media only if real brand/work photography edge-to-edge — otherwise typography-led ink stage is safer. |
| Sticky category rail | **MODIFY** | Keep 4 taxonomy anchors. Do **not** ship orphan white pill strip. Integrate rail into catalog band (same ink→surface transition). Sticky only after hero scrolls away; under site header; compact **text** links with active state; horizontal scroll on mobile. **Reject** Vercel/Notion filter sidebar, search `/`, equal “chip” chrome. |
| Mixed featured / compact rows | **ACCEPT** | Per category: 1 featured interactive row (image + title + 1–2 lines + Explore) + compact list rows for siblings (title, one-line desc, text link — no equal image cards). Fold flagship full-service into Advertising featured (or single lead band once), not Flagship grid + duplicate featured card. |
| Equal 3-col card grids × 4 | **REJECT** | Confirmed monotony; hurts hierarchy and mobile. |
| Marketplace search / dashboard chrome | **REJECT** | Wrong scale; dashboard feel; generic SaaS. |

**SEO / migration guards (non-negotiable):** Keep `/services/` and all 15 `/{slug}/` links; keep category + service fragment IDs already documented; no URL inventiveness; no thin “AI landing” rewrite that drops FAQ/proof.

---

## D) Final recommended section order and behavior

### Desktop

1. **Ink brand stage (hero)** — brand + H1 + one line + primary audit CTA (+ quiet tel). No overlays, no collage, no secondary button weight.
2. **Catalog shell begins** — soft sticky **category rail** (4 text anchors, active on scroll) flush under header once hero leaves.
3. **Capability blocks (×4)** — each: H2 + one sentence; then **featured row** + **compact rows** (Featured-with-list). Account Management is the clear Advertising lead.
4. **How the stack works** — KEEP.
5. **Proof strip** — KEEP verified stats only.
6. **Featured results** — KEEP case links.
7. **FAQ** — KEEP (schema).
8. **Final CTA** — KEEP single audit CTA.

### Mobile

1. Same ink stage (shorter vertical budget; still brand + H1 + one CTA).
2. Sticky thin category scroller (text, not fat pills).
3. Per category: featured block full-width, then compact stacked rows (editorial list — not image-card forever).
4. Stack → proof → results → FAQ → CTA unchanged.

### KEEP from current hub

URL `/services/`, 15 detail links, 4-category taxonomy, flagship *concept*, stack, proof, featured results, FAQ, final CTA, meta/canonical/FAQ schema, mega/footer “all services” pointing here.

### Explicit rejects (hurt SEO or feel AI-generic)

URL changes; `/services/{slug}/` inventiveness; cream + AI product collage; pill overload; purple gradients/glow; hero badges; equal card wallpaper; marketplace search/filters; dashboard sidebars; dual equal CTAs in first viewport.

---

**STATUS:** Research + validation counsel only (no code).  
**VERIFIED:** Live WP `/services/` (different Elementor layout); Vercel Marketplace structure; local hub config/components; staging `/services/` 404.  
**OBSERVED:** User screenshot issues for cream/collage/chip/grid hub.  
**PROPOSED:** Modified ink stage + soft sticky text rail + featured/compact rows.  
**NEXT ACTION:** Approve this prescription before any layout implementation.
